title: Majority complexity on three bits
statement: For inputs in $\{-1,1\}^3$, let majority return $1$ when the sum of the three coordinates is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise. The randomized decision-tree complexity of this function, measured by the infimum of the worst-case expected number of queried coordinates among finite-seed, zero-error randomized decision trees, is at most $8/3$.
